# operationkokua.weebly.com content outline, fetched 2026-11-24 (HST)

## index
TEXT: Mission Statement:
TEXT: Providing surgical education and equipment to orthopedic surgeons, general surgeons, and neurosurgeons in Southeast Asia to improve orthopedic care and rehabilitation for under-served populations.

## donate-to-us
H2: Supplies and Equipment
TEXT: Things that we need include power saws, sterilizable drills, implants, external fixators, Items can be shipped to: 1505 Ohialoke Street
H2: Money
TEXT: Funds are used for shipping, supporting student travel, and purchasing equipment for donations. All board members and executives are all volunteers Currently no funds are used for administrative purposes 501 3 C status currently pending with IRS
